title: The Slowing Course
summary: A course in slowing the passing of time in a limb and a grip and a wound and in laying a short span of slowed time round the user.

title: A Course in Quickened Strikes
summary: A course in strikes and parries whose time runs ahead of the body so that they land before the opponent can answer.

title: The Echo and Delay Handbook
summary: A handbook on repeating a motion a moment later and on holding an effect back until the guard drops and on healing twice with one touch.

title: The Course of Measured Interval
summary: A course on counting the gaps between blows and breaths and using those gaps to read and to guard and to bind and to mend.
